entries.name: Ixekizumab with tirzepatide in psoriatic disease
entries.stage: Completed Phase 3b psoriasis and psoriatic-arthritis studies; Phase 4 follow-up active
entries.summary: Lilly's sponsor-submitted records describe two completed open-label Phase 3b studies of ixekizumab with tirzepatide in adults with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis and obesity or overweight. A 31 August 2026 sponsor release reports prespecified exploratory week-52 findings. Two separate real-world Phase 4 studies have actual March 2025 starts: the psoriasis study is recruiting and the psoriatic-arthritis study is active, not recruiting.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish a UK marketing authorisation for ixekizumab and tirzepatide as a combined psoriatic-disease and weight-management regimen.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access for this combination and specialist research question is established by these studies.
entries.supply: Trial completion, a sponsor announcement and active Phase 4 research do not establish a combined UK treatment pathway, lawful retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The sponsor's week-52 analyses are exploratory, open-label and reported without multiplicity control; detailed results were not peer reviewed in the reviewed release. None of the four registry records has posted results. Lilly reports 274 and 271 enrolled participants in TOGETHER-PsO and TOGETHER-PsA, while the later registry records report 281 and 279 actual participants; both dated accounts remain visible. Skin, joint, weight and metabolic outcomes are indication-specific and do not establish comparative superiority, an approved combined regimen, UK authorisation, NHS access, supply or clinical approval. The Phase 4 enrolment and May 2028 or August 2027 completion dates remain estimates.
